title: The complex of free presheaves of modules attached to a family is exact in positive degrees
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of rings on $X_{\Et}$, and $\mathcal U=\{f_i:U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ a family of morphisms of $X_{\Et}$ with fixed target. For an object $V$ let $\mathcal O_V$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] $W\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\Mor(W,V)}\mathcal O(W)$, the restriction along $\psi:W'\to W$ sending the summand of $\varphi$ to that of $\varphi\circ\psi$ by $\mathcal O(W)\to\mathcal O(W')$ (this is $\mathbf Z_V\otimes_{p,\mathbf Z}\mathcal O$ with $\mathbf Z_V$ the free abelian presheaf on $\Mor(-,V)$); a morphism $V\to V'$ induces $\mathcal O_V\to\mathcal O_{V'}$ by composition. Let $K_\bullet=\mathcal O_{\mathcal U,\bullet}$ be the chain complex of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules with $K_p=\bigoplus_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\mathcal O_{U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}}$ for $p\geq0$, $K_p=0$ for $p<0$, whose differential $K_{p+1}\to K_p$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j$ times the map induced by the projection $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_{p+1}}\to U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\widehat{U_{i_j}}\cdots\times_UU_{i_{p+1}}$. Then $K_\bullet$ is exact in positive degrees: for every object $W$ of $X_{\Et}$ and every $p>0$, $H_p(K_\bullet(W))=0$. (Stacks states this for any category with the fibre products $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F5 (lemma-complex-tensored-still-exact), resting on the proof of Lemma Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex): Z_{U,bullet}(W) is a direct sum over phi : W -> U of the augmented complexes Z[S_phi^{p+1}], each contractible by the homotopy (s_0..s_p) -> (s,s_0..s_p) when S_phi is nonempty; the complex itself is Lemma Tag 03AS (lemma-cech-map-into)

proof.text: Fix an object $W$ of $X_{\Et}$. Exactness of a complex of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules in a degree is checked objectwise, so it suffices to show $H_p(K_\bullet(W))=0$ for $p>0$ (this is what the statement asserts). By the definition of $\mathcal O_V$, $K_p(W)=\bigoplus_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\bigoplus_{\psi\in\Mor(W,U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p})}\mathcal O(W)$, i.e. the free $\mathcal O(W)$-module $\mathcal O(W)[M_p]$ on the set $M_p=\coprod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)}\Mor(W,U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p})$, with basis elements $[(i_0,\ldots,i_p;\psi)]$. The map $\mathcal O_V\to\mathcal O_{V'}$ induced by $g:V\to V'$ sends, at $W$, the summand of $\psi$ identically to the summand of $g\circ\psi$; hence the differential of $K_\bullet(W)$ is the $\mathcal O(W)$-linear map $[(i_0,\ldots,i_{p+1};\psi)]\mapsto\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j[(i_0,\ldots,\widehat{i_j},\ldots,i_{p+1};\mathrm{pr}_{\hat j}\circ\psi)]$, where $\mathrm{pr}_{\hat j}$ is the projection omitting the $j$-th factor.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex), proof, first display (the complex Z_{U,bullet}(V) written as sums of Z[Mor(V, U_{i_0} x_U ... x_U U_{i_p})]); with O(V) coefficients as in the proof of Lemma Tag 03F5 (lemma-complex-tensored-still-exact)

proof.text: For $\varphi\in\Mor(W,U)$ put $\Mor_\varphi(W,U_i)=\{\chi:W\to U_i\mid f_i\circ\chi=\varphi\}$ and $S_\varphi=\coprod_{i\in I}\Mor_\varphi(W,U_i)$. Fibre products of objects of $X_{\Et}$ over $U$ exist in $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. A morphism $\psi:W\to U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$ has a well-defined composite $\varphi:W\to U$ (the structure map of the fibre product), and by the universal property of the iterated fibre product $\psi\mapsto(\mathrm{pr}_0\circ\psi,\ldots,\mathrm{pr}_p\circ\psi)$ is a bijection from the set of such $\psi$ with composite $\varphi$ onto $\Mor_\varphi(W,U_{i_0})\times\cdots\times\Mor_\varphi(W,U_{i_p})$. Composing with a projection $\mathrm{pr}_{\hat j}$ does not change $\varphi$ and corresponds to deleting the $j$-th coordinate. Taking the disjoint union over $(i_0,\ldots,i_p)$ gives a bijection $M_p\cong\coprod_{\varphi\in\Mor(W,U)}S_\varphi^{p+1}$, $(i_0,\ldots,i_p;\psi)\mapsto(\varphi;(i_0,\mathrm{pr}_0\psi),\ldots,(i_p,\mathrm{pr}_p\psi))$, under which $(i_0,\ldots,\widehat{i_j},\ldots,i_{p+1};\mathrm{pr}_{\hat j}\circ\psi)$ corresponds to deleting the $j$-th entry of the tuple in $S_\varphi^{p+2}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex), proof: the sets Mor_phi(V, U_{i_0} x_U ... x_U U_{i_p}) = Mor_phi(V,U_{i_0}) x ... x Mor_phi(V,U_{i_p}), preserved by the projections, and S_phi = coprod_i Mor_phi(V,U_i)

proof.text: Since a free module on a disjoint union is the direct sum of the free modules on the pieces, the first two steps give an isomorphism of chain complexes of $\mathcal O(W)$-modules $K_\bullet(W)\cong\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\Mor(W,U)}C_\bullet(S_\varphi;\mathcal O(W))$, where $C_p(S;A)=A[S^{p+1}]$ with differential $[(s_0,\ldots,s_{p+1})]\mapsto\sum_j(-1)^j[(s_0,\ldots,\widehat{s_j},\ldots,s_{p+1})]$ is the complex of [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible]: the differentials agree on basis elements by the last sentence of the previous step. Homology commutes with direct sums of complexes of modules, so $H_p(K_\bullet(W))\cong\bigoplus_\varphi H_p(C_\bullet(S_\varphi;\mathcal O(W)))$ for every $p$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03AT (lemma-homology-complex), proof: Z[A] + Z[B] = Z[A coprod B], giving the sum over phi of the complexes Z[S_phi^{p+1}]; Lemma Tag 03F5 (lemma-complex-tensored-still-exact), proof, first argument (the same decomposition after tensoring with O(V))

proof.text: Let $p>0$ and $\varphi\in\Mor(W,U)$. If $S_\varphi=\emptyset$ then $C_\bullet(S_\varphi;\mathcal O(W))=0$ and its homology vanishes. If $S_\varphi\neq\emptyset$, then by [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible] (with $A=\mathcal O(W)$, $S=S_\varphi$) the augmented complex $C_\bullet(S_\varphi;\mathcal O(W))\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}\mathcal O(W)$ is exact; its contracting homotopy is $[(s_0,\ldots,s_p)]\mapsto[(s,s_0,\ldots,s_p)]$ for a chosen $s\in S_\varphi$. Exactness of the augmented complex at $C_p$ for $p>0$ is $H_p(C_\bullet(S_\varphi;\mathcal O(W)))=0$ (the augmentation only changes degree $0$). Hence every summand in the previous step vanishes, $H_p(K_\bullet(W))=0$ for all $p>0$ and every $W$, and $K_\bullet$ is exact in positive degrees.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 03F5/03AT (sites-cohomology.tex): it claims exactness in positive degrees only (as 03F5 does; no H_0 claim, which the user lem-weil-pbc-injective-module-abelian-acyclic does not need), and defines O_V directly as the sum of copies of O(W) over Mor(W,V), which equals Z_V tensor_{p,Z} O objectwise; kept unchanged. Wrote the proof of 03AT with O(W) coefficients in four steps: the value at W is the free O(W)-module on the coproduct of the Mor(W, U_{i_0..i_p}) with the alternating projection differential (definition); the universal property of the fibre products in X_et identifies this set with the coproduct over phi: W -> U of S_phi^{p+1}, S_phi = coprod_i Mor_phi(W,U_i), compatibly with face maps; hence K(W) is the direct sum over phi of the complexes O(W)[S_phi^{bullet+1}], and homology commutes with the sum; each summand is zero for S_phi empty and acyclic in positive degrees for S_phi nonempty by the new node lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible (contracting homotopy (s_0..s_p) -> (s,s_0..s_p)).
